Uncle Lim Ep.2: Swap, Don't Stop

Everything you need to post this episode: blog, search meta, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Instagram, Google Business and WhatsApp. Work down the checklist in order.

Video: Uncle_Lim_Ep2_Video.mp4 · 9:16 · 51sUncle_Lim_Ep2_Video_GBP30.mp4Theme: Kopitiam drink & breakfast swapsOutlet: KSL City Mall

Post in this order

  1. Blog postPublish first to get the link
  2. YouTube ShortsAdd blog link in description
  3. TikTokTurn on AI-generated label
  4. Facebook + Instagram ReelsOne caption for both
  5. Google Business postImage + text + button
  6. WhatsApp broadcastLast, with all links
Compliance check before postingChecked against MASA: no scheduled condition named anywhere (video, captions, blog, schema, hashtags); no cure/treat/prevent claims; pharmacist advises swaps and defers to the doctor's plan, no diagnosis, no readings. Google Business: Update post, no phone/URL/hashtags/caps/offers, 1:1 image with minimal text. Sugar figures in the blog are marked approximate (typical in JB) and anchored to WHO guidance. Nothing for Yeoh to confirm: no promo, no prices.

Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Love your morning teh tarik? Try a kopitiam swap instead of giving it up. ☕ In Episode 2 of our Uncle Lim series, Uncle Lim's morning walk had a secret stop: thick teh tarik and kaya butter toast. His daughter caught him, and our pharmacist at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall suggested a simple idea: swap, don't stop. Four easy swaps for your next kopitiam breakfast in Johor Bahru: - Say kurang manis, or kosong when you are ready - Ask for less condensed milk - Add two half-boiled eggs - Ask for a thin spread of kaya Not sure what fits your routine? Walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacist, or ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling. No appointment needed. Lot G-001, Ground Floor, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.
